en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from ‘Ali ibn Ḥakam, from some of his companions, who said: Abū Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.))

asked, “What is the distance between you and the grave of Ḥusain?” I replied, “Sixteen parasangs.” Imam (a.s.) asked, “Do you not go to him?” I replied, “No.” Imam (a.s.) said, “How negligent you people are!!!”
